independentReview.reviewerNote:
The reviewer is a read-only seat that authored none of the delta. Its checks:
- It confirmed that the diff touches only the two files.
- It diffed each cherry-picked #542 patch against its original. The bodies are identical apart from the -x trailer.
- It isolated the final commit's edit. The budget went from 19 to 11 and the ceiling from 4 to 2; both were lowered and nothing was loosened.
- It ran `npx vitest run tools/entry/checkouts.test.mjs` itself: 12/12 passed.
- It ran the combined rev-parse by hand on an unborn, a normal and a detached HEAD. Unborn gave 3 lines and exit 128; the other two exited 0.
- It falsified in a scratch copy outside the worktree. The new test file run against the four-call checkouts.mjs from 4a4ea2d2 failed 5 of 12 tests, all on the spawn budget.

It found nothing blocking and made two non-blocking notes. First, `remote get-url` still swallows stderr, as it did before this change. Second, gitDir survives a failed exit by design.

The author session separately falsified the same budget cases, and also showed that ignoring the exit code fails the unborn case.

The shared Pootytxng account records the verdict as a PR comment whose body names the reviewer identity. The reviewer is a Claude model, independent by role only. The same route was used for the #531 and #533 landings.
